text: 会议指出，体育赛事对于满足群众多元化生活需求、提高人民生活品质具有重要意义。要增加高质量体育赛事供给，盘活用好各类体育场地设施和赛事资源，统筹发展竞技体育赛事、职业赛事和群众赛事。要推动体育赛事与文化、旅游、商务等融合发展，加快新技术运用，提升观赛体验，放大综合效应。要提高赛事管理保障能力，培育一批专业化赛事运营主体，健全场地、人员和机构管理制度，促进各类赛事安全发展。（央视新闻）
text_en: The meeting pointed out that sports events are of great significance for meeting the diverse life needs of the people and improving their quality of life. It is necessary to increase the supply of high-quality sports events, revitalize and make good use of various sports venues, facilities, and event resources, and coordinate the development of competitive sports events, professional events, and mass events. It is necessary to promote the integrated development of sports events with culture, tourism, commerce, and other sectors, accelerate the use of new technologies, improve the spectator experience, and amplify the comprehensive effects. It is necessary to improve event management and support capabilities, cultivate a group of specialized event operating entities, improve management systems for venues, personnel, and institutions, and promote the safe development of various events. (CCTV News)
